project_type: Reconciliation pass on an already-built cross-institution notice verification platform prototype (FinalSay): synchronous FastAPI backend + React/Vite PWA + SQLAlchemy relational DB. The full prototype exists and passed review; this pass aligns it to the authoritative FinalSay-Scope-Note-v2 that was unavailable during the original build.
build_system: Python venv (backend/.venv, created from ~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python) + pip; npm + Vite for frontend; Makefile + scripts/run_demo.sh orchestrate. Run backend commands from backend/ cwd or with PYTHONPATH=backend; package is finalsay.
test_framework: pytest under backend/finalsay/tests/ (in-process TestClient on a temp SQLite DB via conftest.py; conftest provides db_session, client, make_user fixtures). Frontend uses npm run build as the durable smoke.
build_command: make install  (== backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt) ; cd apps/web && npm install && npm run build
test_command: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest finalsay/tests -q   (currently 50 pass). Also: make test.
verification_instructions: 1) cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest finalsay/tests -q  -> all pass. 2) .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.seed.seed twice -> IDENTICAL row counts (idempotent), and benchmark_pairs >= 300. 3) .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal AND --split institution -> both exit 0, print all SIX metrics (field F1, relationship P/R/F1, false-confirmation rate, unresolved rate, Cohen's kappa, time-to-identify) for finalsay + all 4 baselines. 4) cd apps/web && npm run build -> green, emits PWA manifest + sw.js. 5) make eval and make test both succeed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: seed/fixtures/*.json are regenerated by write_fixtures() on every seed run (they are derived artifacts). finalsay.db (SQLite), node_modules, dist, venvs are gitignored. No committed snapshots to update by hand.
setup_instructions: Environment already set up: backend/.venv exists with deps installed; apps/web/node_modules exists. If missing, run make install and (cd apps/web && npm install). Python must be 3.11. All artifacts under /projects/sandbox (NOT /tmp, which is wiped between tool calls).
environment_constraints: Amazon Linux 2023. OPEN_INTERNET (pip/npm work) BUT the demo must keep running with NO paid keys: MOCK comparison model + LOCAL hash-chain anchor by default (preserve this). /tmp is wiped between separate tool calls - keep all artifacts under /projects/sandbox. Background daemons are reaped across tool calls - do NOT rely on a persistent uvicorn/vite; use in-process TestClient for tests and npm run build for frontend. Tesseract binary unavailable - image OCR degrades to HTTP 422; PDF/paste paths work. SQLite is the default DB (Postgres opt-in). No Dockerfile (spec forbids Docker microservices) - docker build is not a verification step.
contribution_requirements: Authoritative scope note (in the user_instruction) WINS over everything. Preserve all points already satisfied (cross-institution >=3, temporal + institution holdout, four baselines, unresolved-when-not-confident, 7-label taxonomy, provenance source_url+retrieved_at+sha256, Merkle daily-root anchoring with Polygon opt-in + local fallback). Seed MUST stay idempotent. Held-out evaluation MUST stay honest: the held-out split (temporal_bucket==1) uses _naturalistic_text phrasings NOT engineered around the mock model's keyword cues - do NOT contaminate it. Unredacted originals must never be persisted (verify, do not just assert). HANDOFF.md MUST be updated with what changed, every autonomous decision, and deviations (user explicitly requires this). Do NOT push or create PRs; leave tree committable.
key_patterns: Benchmark data flows through TWO places that must agree: (a) seed/dataset.py:BENCHMARK_TRIPLES (currently 14 hardcoded (gold, annotator_a, annotator_b) triples) + BENCHMARK_ANNOTATORS = ('reviewer_a','reviewer_b'); (b) seed/seed.py:_seed_benchmark consumes BENCHMARK_TRIPLES index-aligned against non-unresolved gold submission keys to create BenchmarkPair + two BenchmarkAnnotation rows each. Additionally eval/harness.py:benchmark_kappa() reads dataset.BENCHMARK_TRIPLES DIRECTLY (columns [1] and [2]) - so scaling triples updates both the DB seed and the harness kappa. The reviewer API (api/reviewer.py:compute_benchmark_kappa) computes kappa over the two most-active annotators from BenchmarkAnnotation rows in the DB. services/kappa.py:cohen_kappa uses sklearn with a manual fallback and returns 1.0 for a single class. The eval harness scores finalsay + baselines (eval/baselines.py: chronological, page_change, nli, prompted_llm) via evaluate(split, model) -> _score(); metrics live as standalone functions (relationship_metrics, false_confirmation_rate, unresolved_rate) plus field_extraction_f1 and benchmark_kappa. MockComparisonModel.classify(premise, hypothesis) -> (label, confidence, rationale) is the deterministic rule engine.
directory_structure: backend/finalsay/{main,config,db,models,schemas,auth}.py + api/ + services/ + adapters/ + models_iface/ + eval/{harness,baselines}.py + seed/{dataset,seed}.py + seed/fixtures/*.json + tests/ ; apps/web (React+Vite PWA) ; requirements.md/design.md/tasks.md/README.md/HANDOFF.md at root ; Makefile ; scripts/run_demo.sh ; task state under .agents/tasks/.
